title: I made four tiny daily puzzle games. They're now an Android app too (no ads, no accounts)
author: sonickong
selftext:
Hi all. Long-time player, first-time maker here. I'm between jobs at the moment, so I've been building a small collection of daily puzzles called DAILY ROM. One new puzzle per game per day, the same for everyone, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking.

It's now on Google Play as well as in the browser:

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=games.dailyrom.app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=games.dailyrom.app)

[https://dailyrom.games](https://dailyrom.games)

The four games:

* NULLFIELD: a mine-sweeping puzzle where no board ever needs a guess.
* OXIDE: fit the blocks; whatever you leave behind rusts.
* CONJECTURE: a hidden rule, and you find it by trying to be wrong.
* DEADHAND: write the plan first, then watch the level change.

Full disclosure: I built these with AI assistance (Claude). I design, direct, test and publish; the AI writes much of the code, and I review and test what it produces. I'd rather say that up front than have anyone wonder.

I'd really value honest feedback, especially on the first thirty seconds of each game. What's confusing? What would make you come back tomorrow? I'll reply to everyone.

(Mods: happy to move this to the right thread if there is one.)
